@@U03737@@
that brought us here so suddenly, somehow,
without ever taking a step.
Or, confused perhaps, she wanders this maze
of many castles made into one,
looking for its master
to prepare you a princely welcome.
But there!
Look, up there!
I see a stir, a commotion,
crowds thronging galleries,
at windows, at every entrance!
Servants, many, scurrying every which way!
What else but a fitting reception
to honor Your Highness?

@@U03739@@
Ah! How my heart leaps at the sight!
Look! Look at them!
How decorously they walk,
with such calm, unhurried step,
those dear, those lovely fair-skinned boys!
Down the stairs, so properly they come,
and in such order!
But how can it be?
Who can have ordered,
who can have trained
so wondrous a company of beautiful lads?
And in so little time!
What shall I admire most?
The grace of their walk,
the delicate curls adorning their radiant brows,
or their cheeks, ruddy as peaches,
and just as downy?
I'd bite them if I dared,
but of course I don’t;
dreadful to tell, but once,
in a similar case, the mouth was
filled with ashes.
translation:
@@U03737@@
不知何故，突然把我们带到这里，
从未迈出一步。
或者，也许她很困惑，在这个迷宫中徘徊
将许多城堡合而为一，
寻找它的主人
为您准备隆重的欢迎仪式。
但是就在那里！
看，上面！
我看到一阵骚动、一阵骚动，
画廊里人头攒动，
在窗户，在每个入口！
仆人很多，到处乱窜！
除了合适的接待还有什么
为了尊敬殿下？

@@U03739@@
啊！我的心一看见就狂跳！
看！看看他们！
他们走路多么优雅，
如此从容不迫的脚步，
那些亲爱的、那些可爱的皮肤白皙的男孩们！
下楼梯，他们来得很恰当，
并且按照这样的顺序！
但怎么可能呢？
谁可以订购，
谁可以受训
这么一群漂亮小伙子真是太神奇了？
而且是在这么短的时间内！
我最欣赏什么？
他们行走的优雅，
精致的卷发装饰着明亮的眉毛，
或者他们红润如桃子的脸颊，
和一样柔和？
如果我敢的话我会咬他们
但我当然不知道；
说起来很可怕，但有一次，
在类似的情况下，嘴巴
充满灰烬。
